test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Six friends are sitting in a circle. All of them are facing the centre. Palak is an immediate neighbour of Kumud. Jhalak sits third to the left of Mehak. Rahat sits fourth to the right of Jhalak. Kumud sits second to the right of Chahak.

Who sits to the immediate left of Mehak?
solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. Jhalak sits third to the left of Mehak and Rahat sits fourth to the right of Jhalak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfca0b16e58439f9b214b6494ab6b5f8e3685037a6c81fbb43b691f10ce199be.png] 

2. Palak is an immediate neighbour of Kumud and Kumud sits second to the right of Chahak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3831e35dfd86ba7f356221613ba89e2c7e70732208043cc25a750381b8a4e8f3.png] 

Here,** 'Palak' **sits to the immediate left of Mehak.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
